pattern: なんか / なんて / など
purpose: Present something as an example, sometimes with dismissal or surprise.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
express feelings speak politely show respect
Noun + なんか / なんて / など; quoted clause + なんて
How about a movie or something this weekend?
It is too difficult for someone like me.
It is amazing that you finished it by yourself.
formation: Noun + なんか / なんて / など; quoted clause + なんて
register: Conversational; など is more formal
restrictions: Tone determines whether the expression is modest, dismissive, or surprised.
mistake: なんて can belittle a person or thing; avoid it in respectful descriptions.
